problem_statement: The Zephyr Memory Storage (ZMS) key-value store only supports 32-bit identifiers: its public API takes a uint32_t id, and its on-flash allocation table entry (ATE) reserves 32 bits for the id. Applications that need an identifier namespace larger than 32 bits cannot use ZMS. Add optional support for 64-bit identifiers: a zms_id_t type whose width is selected at build time by a Kconfig option, a corresponding ATE format that reserves 64 bits for the id, and the matching write/read/delete/history behaviour so that entries with 64-bit ids can be stored, looked up, and read back correctly (including distinguishing ids that share the same low 32 bits but differ in the high 32 bits).
